Martina Capurro Taborda [ a ] (born 4 December 1997) is an Argentine tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of  No. 149, achieved on 15 January 2024. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of No. 380, attained on 27 November 2023. Capurro Taborda made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2016 Brasil Tennis Cup , where she entered the tournament as a lucky loser, after losing in the final qualifying round.
